About this tool

This Plan Illustrator is an internal pilot tool for generating client illustrations. It has not yet been formally approved for official company use or client distribution. It is provided for evaluation and field-testing purposes only.

By continuing, you acknowledge and agree that:

  • You are an authorised agent or representative acting on your own responsibility.
  • Every figure you enter is your own responsibility to verify for accuracy before relying on or sharing any output.
  • Any illustration generated is for discussion purposes only and is not a binding offer, quotation, or policy document unless separately confirmed through official channels.
  • You are solely responsible for how you use, print, share, or distribute any document this tool produces, including to clients or third parties.
  • The company has not authorised this tool for production use, and accepts no liability for outcomes arising from its use or from documents generated by it.
  • Your name, agency code, phone number and email address will be recorded on this device and included on illustrations you generate, for accountability and traceability purposes. You can correct them at any time from the Account menu, and you must sign out when someone else is going to use this device.
  • Data & usage monitoring. When this app is connected to its administrator service, the system records your name, agency code, phone number and email address together with how you use the app — which features and products you open or calculate, when, the app version, whether it is installed on your device, and any errors that occur — and may share this with the system administrators and the system owner for internal reporting, support, security and improving the system. Information you enter about your clients (such as their names, dates of birth and amounts) stays on your device and is not collected. Feedback you send through the app is emailed to the system owner together with your name and phone number. To have your data corrected or removed, contact the system administrator.
